blocks.title: Let’s learn the parts of a baseball player’s uniform

blocks.text: Baseball is the sport people like most. There are many stadiums in the largest cities in the world. Baseball games can be watched on almost any T.V. Channel by means of satellite connection if available in the city or country where it’s being played. Let’s see what happens in the stadium now……
The Red Socks are playing against the White Socks from Chicago:

items: *Bill:* Hey! There is Pete Brown the best batter.
*Tom:* Yes, he is! I can see him talking to the manager of the White Socks.
*Bill:* The games are very interesting this year.
*Tom:* I think so. I prefer to come when they have an extra inning….
*Vicky:* Can I have a hot dog?
*Bill:* Sure. Bring me a hamburger and a soda.
*Bill:* Oh! sorry. Will you please do me a favor Vicky?
*Bill:* Bring me a lemonade rather than a soda. Right?
*Vicky:* All right. I’ll be back right away.
*Vicky:* It’s too late. I can’t wait for your order. Sorry!

items.q: What is Vicky going to do?

items: Armando has a cold. *He feels weak.*
Mr. Bernal has sold his new book. He feels all right.
Carla has lost her handbag. She feels very bad.

items.q: – If you are sick, you feel
– If you get a terrible cold, you feel
– If your sister wins a free trip to Miami, she will feel
– If your color T.V. is broken, you feel
– If you get a nice new job, you will feel
Could you be happy if you were sick?
Would you buy a book about a sad story?
Could you be unhappy if you won $ 1.000?
Are you glad or sad now?
